workload.description: symmetrised S4 (b = 1) in e-variables with correspondence, V = <1..z^(l-1)>, n = 3l, l = 3, 4, 5, random target abscissae (polynomial-level decomposition, no curve group)

metric: F4 word XORs per solve (median over targets x rounds)
note: Convolution split (f = X1 X2): degree 3 -> 2, 4-14% fewer monomials, same split tree, 1.21-2.07x more word ops and 2.4-2.9x wall time. Lucas factorisation has no counterpart for F_{2^n}-valued summands; m = 4 measured at correspondence level only (no binary symmetrised S5 in the repo).
